description: Verify that the Type field of the IPv4 Multicast Option is 0x14 (SOME/IP-SD §5.1.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Wire-format invariant for the IPv4 Multicast Option: Type == 0x14.

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT emits a qualifying SD message containing the option (typically an OfferService).
Observation: option's Type field == 0x14.   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Type on the wire equals 0x14.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_type — No IPv4 multicast option with type 0x14
• Fail_timeout — no qualifying SD message within listen window

verdicts.Fail_type: No IPv4 multicast option with type 0x14
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying SD message within listen window
